integrity: All mathematics is restricted to finite simple undirected friendship graphs with r>=2; no independent validation or infinite-computation certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: For all r>=2 the conclusion is a universal upper bound and hub-positive sufficiency theorem, not a claim of exact equality for r>=4. Equality is established by exhaustive enumeration only for r=2,3. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A hub-reserve clearing bound for friendship graphs
